validation_notes: Since late June, ETH has been in a mild uptrend, bouncing from ~1550 to ~1900-1950 and then consolidating in a fairly tight sideways range (roughly 1830-1950) with no clear convergence between highs and lows. The recent price action looks more like a flat/rectangular consolidation than a converging triangle — highs are roughly flat around 1920-1950 and lows are roughly flat around 1830-1870, not narrowing toward an apex. There's no strong evidence of two converging trendlines; it's more of a sideways channel after a sharp recovery rally. I don't see the compression required for a credible symmetric triangle at the right edge.
